text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved results in GⅠ races, Tosen 
Jordan was finally approached for a media 
scrum interview!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, her mind went completely blank 
from nervousness. Furthermore, the 
questions were on the difficult side for 
her. In the end, her brain overloaded... 
leaving a bitter aftertaste.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a hint of frustration, she says that 
as long as the Satsuki Sho results show 
everyone how seriously she takes 
competing, that's enough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"...Yet there was also a reporter quietly 
watching over Tosen Jordan."
